statement: The same MOP token identity will recur in the <=100-bp OUTSIDE_GENE boundary role across genome pairs more often than expected after preserving the exact marginal number of boundary-role token types in ECOLI, PYRO and YEAST.
support_condition: one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail for S_pair <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
weakening_condition: S_pair above null mean but tail >0.05.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before token-level cross-genome boundary-role overlap counts were calculated.
